sections.title: 1.1 Why spacing works
sections.html:
Memories fade quickly after we first learn something. Each time we successfully recall an idea, the memory becomes more stable and fades more slowly. Spaced repetition uses this: it schedules each review just before you would forget.

Recall beats rereading

Actively retrieving an answer strengthens memory far more than rereading the same page. That is why every section in this app ends with questions.

Try it

Close your eyes and summarise this paragraph in one sentence.
sections.summary: Recall strengthens memories, and spacing reviews just before forgetting makes them last longer.

keyTerms.definition: reviewing material at increasing intervals, timed just before forgetting
actively recalling information instead of rereading it

options: Each review just before you would forget
All reviews on the same day
items.explanation: Spaced repetition times each review just before the memory would fade.
Retrieval (actively recalling) strengthens memory far more than rereading.

items.prompt: Explain in your own words why recall beats rereading.

sections.title: 1.2 The box ladder
sections.html:
This app sorts every question into one of seven boxes. A new question starts in box 0 and is due immediately. A correct answer moves it up one box; a wrong answer sends it back to box 1.

Results
ScoreEffect
2–3up one box
1down one box (min. 1)
0back to box 1, counts a lapse
sections.summary: Seven boxes with growing intervals; correct answers move up, wrong answers reset to box 1.

keyTerms.definition: a forgotten item that falls back to box 1

items.prompt: Where does a new question start?
options: In no box until answered twice
items.explanation: New questions start in box 0, which has an interval of 0 days.

items.prompt: What happens after a wrong answer?
options: The question moves up one box
The question goes back to box 1
items.explanation: A wrong answer (score 0) resets the question to box 1 and counts a lapse.

items.prompt: How many days until the next review for a question in box 3?
items.explanation: The intervals are 0, 1, 3, 7, 16, 35, 90 days for boxes 0–6, so box 3 waits 7 days.
